notes: Summary: startup building low-latency conversational features for retail customer support and live product recommendation. Very cost-sensitive on embeddings (high QPS) and tail-latency sensitive for chat (p95 SLA).
CTO (A. Rao): 'We cannot accept >50ms p95 on short-turn chat decisions; average token budgets small but bursty traffic from webhooks.'

AE notes: strong interest in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching/caching/quantization) and Dedicated pools for predictable latency. Asking for quantization profiles that preserve top-1 accuracy for reranking models.
Security: requires SOC2 + KMS integration, audit logs forwarded to Splunk, ability to host control plane in VPC. On-prem option requested for two regulated clients.
Cost target: embeddings below $0.0005 / vector; overall hosting target to keep inference spend < 30% of app revenue for first year.
Quote from ML lead: 'We want automated suggestions for batching and cache TTLs by workload — manual tuning burned months.'
Competitive notes: currently running a self-hosted Triton + A100 setup; primary question: 'does Redwood deliver better unit economics while meeting sub-50ms tails?'
Team: infra lead (R. Patel), ML lead (L. Nguyen), CTO (A. Rao).

workload_summary: Two primary workloads: 1) chat agent (short prompts, average 30 tokens per request) with strict p95 target <= 50ms; bursty QPS up to 600 rps per region during peak. 2) embeddings pipeline for semantic search (dense vectors), sustained QPS ~1200, cost-sensitive; reranking jobs occasional but latency-critical (100ms SLA). Interested in dynamic batching, prefix/KV caching for chat, and int8 / AWQ quantization for embeddings and rerankers with measured quality degradation thresholds.
perf_benchmark_requests: Compare Redwood Dedicated runtime vs current Triton + A100 baseline for chat: measure p50/p95/p99 for short-seq (<=64 tokens) and cold/warm KV cache scenarios
Batching experiments: evaluate dynamic batching thresholding and impact on latency under burst traffic (spike test: 0->600 rps in 30s)
Quantization trials: AWQ/int8 on reranker and embedder; report ROC-AUC/regression on held-out eval set and latency/cost delta
Cache policy assessment: prefix caching for chat and vector cache for embeddings to estimate token savings and effective unit cost reduction
Soak test: 10-day steady-state on Dedicated with production traffic replay to validate autoscaling and failover/rollback behavior
poc_plan: Phase 0 (week 0): credentials, traffic sample upload, security handshake (SAML test account), NDA in review
Phase 1 (week 1-2): spin up Dedicated pool, run baseline Redwood perf tests against synthetic and replayed traces
Phase 2 (week 3): enable Optimize suggestions (batching profiles, cache TTLs, quantization) and re-run benchmarks
Phase 3 (week 4): compare model variants and implement canary routing + fallback to smaller model under load
Phase 4 (week 5-6): customer-run soak test and joint review; deliver final TCO and recommendation report
